one_line_contribution: A token-matched and format-matched control set (correct top-k vs. off-query decoys vs. one fixed prefix vs. an offline-compiled instruction) applied to agentic experience memory, paired with a measured experience-following rate, to argue that the per-query conditioning step contributes zero while the bank still contributes query-independently.
closest_prior_work: The proposal's own list is not the real threat; the threat is the in-context-learning demonstration-selection literature it never cites. Min et al. 2022 (Rethinking the Role of Demonstrations) established the template argument -- swap the semantically correct content of demonstrations for mismatched content at fixed format and fixed count, observe no accuracy loss, and conclude the model is reading format and distribution rather than the query-specific payload -- and Yoo et al. 2022 and the Z-ICL line refined it. The counterweight, Liu et al. 2022 (KATE / What Makes Good In-Context Examples for GPT-3), showed retrieval-based selection does beat random selection, and the subsequent literature has repeatedly found the gain small and dataset-dependent. Predictions 1-3 are that decade-old ablation ported from static classification ICL to agentic trajectories, and an area chair will ask what is conceptually new beyond the port. The proposal can answer that -- agentic memory items are procedures used over multi-step rollouts, not label-bearing exemplars, and no one has run the swap inside a deployed agent memory stack -- but it does not answer it, because it never notices the literature. Within its own list, ExpeL (arXiv:2308.10144) threatens least (it contains the insight/trajectory split but not the token-matched swap) and Dynamic Cheatsheet (arXiv:2504.07952) plus the claimed Atlas (arXiv:2603.15666) threaten only the compilation half, which the proposal correctly concedes.
strongest_objection: There is no pre-registered gate requiring the retrieval channel to be worth anything before its query-conditioning is declared inert, and the track's own prior measurement makes the ungated world the likely one. The brief this proposal answers reports that injecting seven retrieved items fixed zero items and broke six to seven (McNemar p=0.031, p=0.016, replicated), and that cutting to three items eliminated the harm. The centerpiece then makes A1(7) the canonical read and builds every equivalence claim on it. If A1(7) - A0 is at or below zero on WebShop, prediction 1 is satisfied trivially: decoys match correct retrieval because neither is worth anything, and the paper has shown that a channel with no value has no query-specific value -- which is the track's already-published result restated with more conditions. Prediction 1's own escape hatch, the 'at least 80 percent of whatever advantage correct retrieval holds over A0 survives replacement' formulation, is undefined when the denominator is near zero or negative, and no inference procedure or minimum denominator is pre-registered for that ratio. The guard against this is A5, the oracle nearest-gold trajectory, which the Risk section explicitly names as the arm that decides whether the finding generalizes -- yet A5 sits in the supporting tier at one seed with no null replicate, no MDE, and no TOST margin. The single arm that determines which paper this is is the least powered one in the grid. Compounding this, the only contrast that overturns a published result is prediction 6 on ALFWorld (B1 vs. B2, B4, B5), and the Measurement section states in plain words that ALFWorld at n approximately 234 cannot support equivalence claims (MDE 7-8 points). Prediction 6 is an equivalence claim on ALFWorld. The proposal contradicts itself on its own headline consequence: the powered environments have no published claim to overturn, and the environment with the published claim to overturn is conceded to be unable to support the test.
what_would_fix_it: Four changes, none expensive. (1) Pre-register an interpretability gate: state the minimum A1(7) - A0 and A5 - A0 above the measured noise floor below which the equivalence claims are reported as uninformative rather than as support for inertness, and commit to that reframing in advance the way risk 3 already commits for P1 approximately equal to P0. (2) Promote A5 and A6 into the decisive set at two seeds with their own null replicates and MDEs; the oracle is not a supporting curiosity, it is the denominator of the entire claim. (3) Move prediction 6 off ALFWorld or drop the equivalence language there. Either pool the seen and unseen splits into a single larger ALFWorld evaluation, or port the B1-B5 decomposition onto WebShop and E3 using an ExpeL-style write path so the ExpeL logic is tested where the power lives, and let n approximately 234 ALFWorld carry direction only, exactly as the Measurement section says it must. (4) Strengthen the decoy. A2(7) drawn from a disjoint task family is the easy negative; add hard negatives drawn from ranks 24-30 of A6's own 30-candidate pool for the current query -- same topic, same environment, same format, wrong ranking -- so the claim separates 'ranking quality is inert' from the much weaker 'topical relevance is inert'. Also state whether the TOST tests are themselves Holm-corrected across the ten-row conditioning family; if they are, the stated MDE of 0.031 reward at a TOST margin of 0.03 no longer delivers the advertised power, and the margins or n need revising.
missing_baseline: Two, plus one symmetry gap. First, the entire conditioning block at k=3: A2(3) and A3(3) do not exist anywhere in the grid, and A1(3) is demoted to supporting at one seed. The track's own prior work identified k=3 as the injection budget at which memory stops being harmful, which makes it the operating point where conditioning has the best chance of showing value -- each item carries more weight, distraction is minimal, and there is no seven-item length penalty to swamp the signal. Testing conditioning only at the budget already known to be harmful stacks the deck toward the null. Second, hard-negative decoys from the same query's own candidate pool (see above); without them the result reads as 'off-topic text is ignorable', which is unsurprising, rather than 'ranking within topic is worthless', which is the interesting claim. The symmetry gap: A2u swaps in a foreign environment's bank at retrieval time, but there is no P1u that compiles a foreign environment's bank into an instruction. P0 (bank-blind) bounds compilation from one side only; P1u would test whether P1's gain over P0 is bank-specific content or merely more agent-flavored instruction text, which is what prediction 7 actually needs.
preprint_collision: Procedurally this is among the better collision checks one sees -- nine queries, two collisions named rather than buried, a live counter-hypothesis (arXiv:2606.06036) reported as a threat to significance, an explicit statement that the gap claim is a claim about the search and not proof of absence, and a named consequence if the Atlas group adds a decoy arm. Substantively it is much weaker than it looks, and the proposal itself supplies the reason. The 'Correction carried forward' paragraph concedes that the previous round cited five items (MemHarness 2607.28272, RecMem 2605.16045, AtomicRAG 2604.20844, Distractor-Aware Truncation 2608.03297, and a retitled 2606.06036) that this round's search could not re-verify, and that arXiv:2604.04373, previously flagged as the closest threat, did not reappear at all. The same retrieval apparatus produced this round's eight items, and the author admits verifying Atlas only from an introduction snippet with no confirmed venue or authorship. So the load-bearing collision -- the one that determines whether the compilation half is preempted -- rests on an unverified artifact, and the honest inference is that the current eight need independent confirmation (title, authors, abstract, ablation table) before novelty can be granted on their basis. Of the cited set I can vouch for ExpeL (2308.10144), AWM (2409.07429), and Dynamic Cheatsheet (2504.07952); the 2603-2608 identifiers I cannot. Separately, the search's scope is too narrow to establish the novelty claimed: every query appears to sit inside agentic memory, so it could not have surfaced the ICL demonstration-selection line (Min et al. 2022, Liu et al. 2022, Yoo et al. 2022) where mismatched-content and random-selection controls at fixed format are routine methodology. An unsearched adjacent literature that already runs your central ablation in a neighboring setting is a novelty problem, not a neutral, and it is the one this check missed.
